records.label: spacr.diameter#3
records.source: Design constraint: this module must be usable *before* committing to a segmentation run, which means it may not cost what a segmentation run costs. It therefore imports **no torch and no cellpose** — that is a tested property, not an aspiration (see ``tests/test_diameter_estimator.py``). It reuses :mod:`spacr.validate` for filename-metadata parsing, which is the other deliberately dependency-light module in the package (``spacr.utils``, where ``_get_regex`` and ``_extract_filename_metadata`` live, imports torch and cellpose at module scope and so cannot be touched from here). The regexes in ``spacr.validate.METADATA_REGEXES`` mirror ``spacr.utils._get_regex``, and the channel ordering used below mirrors ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files``, which concatenates one plane per distinct ``chanID`` in sorted order — so channel index *i* is the *i*-th sorted ``chanID``, exactly as ``cell_channel`` and friends mean it.
records.context: *Early availability:* the module works before segmentation. **Lightweight dependencies:** it avoids torch and cellpose. This is tested by ``tests/test_diameter_estimator.py``. :mod:`spacr.validate` parses filename metadata without heavy imports. The alternative ``spacr.utils`` imports torch and cellpose because it defines ``_get_regex`` and ``_extract_filename_metadata``. Equivalent rules appear in ``spacr.validate.METADATA_REGEXES`` and ``spacr.utils._get_regex``. ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files`` sorts planes by ``chanID``. Position *i* selects one entry. At position *i*, the sorted ``chanID`` corresponds to ``cell_channel``.
records.translation: *शीघ्र उपलब्धता:* यह मॉड्यूल विभाजन से पहले काम करता है। **हल्की निर्भरताएँ:** यह torch और cellpose से बचता है। इसे ``tests/test_diameter_estimator.py`` जाँचता है। :mod:`spacr.validate` भारी आयातों के बिना फ़ाइलनाम मेटाडेटा पढ़ता है। दूसरा विकल्प ``spacr.utils`` है, जो ``_get_regex`` और ``_extract_filename_metadata`` परिभाषित करने के कारण torch और cellpose आयात करता है। समान नियम ``spacr.validate.METADATA_REGEXES`` और ``spacr.utils._get_regex`` में हैं। ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files`` तल को ``chanID`` के अनुसार क्रमित करता है। स्थान *i* एक प्रविष्टि चुनता है। स्थान *i* पर क्रमित ``chanID`` वही है जिसे ``cell_channel`` दर्शाता है।

records.label: spacr.diameter#6
records.source: 1. **Flatten.** Denoise with a 1 px Gaussian, then subtract a heavily smoothed copy (sigma = max(32, min(H, W) / 4)) to remove illumination gradients. The sigma is deliberately far larger than any plausible object so that flattening removes vignetting without eating the objects — the opposite trade-off (a tight rolling ball) shrinks what it is trying to measure. 2. **Reject noise.** Compare the structural amplitude of the flattened plane (p99 - p30) against the *pixel-level* noise scale, measured as ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` on the raw plane. A pure-noise plane scores below 1; a plane with real objects scores in the tens. Below ``min_snr`` the field is discarded rather than thresholded, because Otsu will happily bisect pure noise and hand back a confident-looking number. 3. **Threshold and label.** Otsu, fill holes, label, drop components that touch the image border (truncated, so their size is a lie) and components that are absurd (equivalent diameter below ``min_object_diameter``, or area above ``max_object_fraction`` of the field). Characteristic size is the median equivalent diameter, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Cross-check by distance transform.** Step 3 has one dominant failure mode: a confluent monolayer fuses into a single component, that component touches the border and is dropped, and the estimate is then computed from whatever debris survived — biased **low**, and silently. So the Euclidean distance transform of the (unfilled) foreground is computed as well, its local maxima are taken as one seed per object (two passes: a coarse pass sets the suppression radius for the refined pass), and a watershed on ``-EDT`` splits the fused foreground back into objects whose equivalent diameters are measured the same way.
records.context: 1. **Flatten.** Apply a 1 px Gaussian filter, then subtract a smoother copy with sigma = max(32, min(H, W) / 4). This sigma is larger than a plausible object, so it removes vignetting without the object shrinkage caused by a tight rolling ball. 2. **Reject noise.** Compare the flattened plane’s structural amplitude (p99 - p30) with the *pixel-level* raw-plane noise estimate ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))``. Pure noise scores below 1; real objects score in the tens. Discard a field below ``min_snr`` instead of applying Otsu to pure noise. 3. **Threshold and label.** Apply Otsu, fill holes, and label components. Remove border-touching components because they are truncated; also remove equivalent diameters below ``min_object_diameter`` and areas above ``max_object_fraction``. Use the median equivalent diameter, ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)``. 4. **Cross-check by distance transform.** A confluent layer can fuse into one border-touching component, which is discarded and leaves debris that biases the estimate silently **low**. Compute the Euclidean distance transform of the unfilled foreground. Use local maxima as object seeds in two passes: a coarse pass sets the suppression radius for the refined pass. Watershed on ``-EDT`` separates the fused foreground before measuring equivalent diameters the same way.
records.translation: 1. **समतल करें।** 1 px Gaussian फ़िल्टर लगाएँ, फिर ऐसी अधिक चिकनी प्रति घटाएँ जिसका sigma मान अधिकतम(32, न्यूनतम(H, W) / 4) है। यह sigma किसी संभावित वस्तु से बड़ा है, इसलिए कसकर फिट किए rolling ball से होने वाली वस्तु-सिकुड़न के बिना vignette हटाता है। 2. **शोर अस्वीकार करें।** समतल तल के संरचनात्मक आयाम (p99 - p30) की तुलना कच्चे तल के *पिक्सेल-स्तरीय* शोर अनुमान ``1.4826 * MAD(img - gaussian(img, 1))`` से करें। शुद्ध शोर का स्कोर 1 से कम और वास्तविक वस्तुओं का स्कोर दहाइयों में होता है। ``min_snr`` से नीचे के दृश्य-क्षेत्र को शुद्ध शोर पर Otsu लगाने के बजाय छोड़ दें। 3. **सीमा निर्धारित कर लेबल करें।** Otsu लगाएँ, छिद्र भरें और घटकों को लेबल करें। सीमा छूने वाले घटकों को हटाएँ क्योंकि वे कटे हुए हैं; ``min_object_diameter`` से छोटे समतुल्य व्यास और ``max_object_fraction`` से बड़े क्षेत्र भी हटाएँ। माध्यिका समतुल्य व्यास ``2 * sqrt(area / pi)`` प्रयोग करें। 4. **दूरी-रूपांतरण से पुनः जाँचें।** सघन परत एक सीमा-छूते घटक में जुड़ सकती है; उसे हटाने पर बचा मलबा अनुमान को चुपचाप **कम** कर देता है। अधूरे अग्रभूमि का Euclidean दूरी-रूपांतरण निकालें। दो चरणों में स्थानीय अधिकतमों को वस्तु बीज बनाएँ: मोटा चरण परिष्कृत चरण की दमन त्रिज्या तय करता है। ``-EDT`` पर watershed जुड़ी अग्रभूमि अलग करता है, फिर समतुल्य व्यास उसी तरह मापे जाते हैं।

records.label: spacr.filters#3
records.source: **Why a separate table.** The columns could be added to ``cell``, but a gate is not a measurement: it is an interpretation, it is re-drawn often, and it belongs to whichever object the user was looking at. Writing into the measurement tables would mix the two, and re-gating would rewrite a table that the measure step owns. ``filters`` is written only by this module, so it can be deleted and rebuilt at any time without losing a measurement.
records.context: **Why a separate table.** The columns could be added to ``cell``, but a data-selection boundary is not a measurement: it is an interpretation, it is re-drawn often, and it belongs to whichever object the user was looking at. Writing into the measurement tables would mix the two, and re-data-selection filtering would rewrite a table that the measure step owns. ``filters`` is written only by this module, so it can be deleted and rebuilt at any time without losing a measurement.
records.translation: **अलग तालिका क्यों।** स्तंभ ``cell`` में जोड़े जा सकते थे, लेकिन डेटा-चयन सीमा कोई मापन नहीं है: वह एक व्याख्या है, बार-बार पुनः बनाई जाती है और उस वस्तु से संबंधित है जिसे उपयोगकर्ता देख रहा था। मापन तालिकाओं में लिखना दोनों को मिला देगा, और दोबारा डेटा-चयन करने पर measure चरण के स्वामित्व वाली तालिका फिर लिखी जाएगी। ``filters`` केवल यह मॉड्यूल लिखता है, इसलिए किसी मापन को खोए बिना इसे कभी भी हटाकर फिर बनाया जा सकता है।

records.label: spacr.gui_elements.AnnotateApp.load_single_image#1
records.source: The crop is read through :func:`spacr.crops.read_crop_png`, not ``Image.open``, because a crop PNG is format-versioned: anything written before the BGR fix holds ``png_dims[0]`` in its *blue* channel, and showing that as-is means every red/green/blue control in this window points at the wrong stain. The reader corrects a legacy folder on load (and narrows 16-bit crops by their high byte instead of letting PIL clip a single-channel one to solid white), so old and new datasets look the same here.
records.context: The extracted image region is read through :func:`spacr.crops.read_crop_png`, not ``Image.open``, because an extracted-image-region PNG is format-versioned: anything written before the BGR fix holds ``png_dims[0]`` in its *blue* image data channel, and showing that as-is means every red/green/blue control in this window points at the wrong stain. The reader corrects a legacy folder on load (and narrows 16-bit extracted image regions by their high byte instead of letting PIL clip a single-image data channel one to solid white), so old and new datasets look the same here.
records.translation: निकाला गया छवि क्षेत्र :func:`spacr.crops.read_crop_png` से पढ़ा जाता है, ``Image.open`` से नहीं, क्योंकि निकाले-गए-छवि-क्षेत्र PNG का प्रारूप संस्करणित है: BGR सुधार से पहले लिखी किसी भी फ़ाइल में ``png_dims[0]`` उसके *नीले* छवि-डेटा चैनल में होता है, और उसे जस का तस दिखाने पर इस विंडो के सभी लाल/हरे/नीले नियंत्रण गलत stain की ओर संकेत करेंगे। रीडर लोड करते समय पुराने फ़ोल्डर को सुधारता है (और 16-बिट निकाले गए क्षेत्रों को उच्च बाइट से संकुचित करता है, बजाय PIL को एकल-छवि-डेटा-चैनल चित्र को पूर्ण सफ़ेद काटने देने के), इसलिए पुराने और नए डेटासेट यहाँ समान दिखते हैं।

records.label: spacr.openmp_guard#3
records.source: xgboost's runtime handed torch's runtime a ``kmp_info_t *`` out of its own thread table; torch's build read it at its own struct offsets and dereferenced field 0x580 of something else entirely. libomp normally refuses to be initialised twice and says so ("OMP: Error #15"), but TensorFlow sets ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK=True`` process-wide, which turns that guard off and leaves the corruption silent.
records.context: xgboost's runtime handed torch's runtime a ``kmp_info_t *`` out of its own independent execution path table; torch's build read it at its own struct offsets and dereferenced field 0x580 of something else entirely. libomp normally refuses to be initialised twice and says so ("OMP: Error #15"), but TensorFlow sets ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK=True`` process-wide, which turns that guard off and leaves the corruption silent.
records.translation: xgboost के runtime ने अपनी स्वतंत्र execution-path तालिका से ``kmp_info_t *`` torch के runtime को दिया; torch के build ने उसे अपने struct offsets पर पढ़ा और किसी बिल्कुल अलग वस्तु का field 0x580 dereference कर दिया। libomp सामान्यतः दूसरी बार initialize होने से मना करके "OMP: Error #15" बताता है, लेकिन TensorFlow पूरे process में ``KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK=True`` सेट करता है; इससे वह guard बंद हो जाता है और corruption मौन रह जाता है।

records.label: spacr.power_model.scan_parameters#14
records.source: **Returning exactly ``False`` stops the sweep** and returns the rows completed so far; anything else (including ``None``) continues.  This exists for one reason: a sweep is minutes long and a GUI has to be able to show where it is and to stop it without killing the thread.  Between points is the only safe granularity — one fit is atomic — so a cancel is honoured after the fit in flight, not during it.  The callback runs on the calling thread, inline; it must not block, and a callback that raises aborts the sweep rather than being swallowed, because a broken progress reporter is a bug in the caller and hiding it would leave the sweep running with nothing watching it.
records.context: **Returning exactly ``False`` stops the sweep** and returns the rows completed so far; anything else (including ``None``) continues.  This exists for one reason: a sweep is minutes long and a GUI has to be able to show where it is and to stop it without killing the independent execution path.  Between points is the only safe granularity — one fit is atomic — so a cancel is honoured after the fit in flight, not during it.  The callback executes on the calling independent execution path, inline; it must not block, and a callback that raises aborts the sweep rather than being swallowed, because a broken progress reporter is a bug in the caller and hiding it would leave the sweep executing with nothing watching it.
records.translation: **ठीक ``False`` लौटाने पर sweep रुकता है** और अब तक पूरी हुई पंक्तियाँ लौटती हैं; अन्य कोई भी मान (``None`` सहित) जारी रखता है। इसका एक ही कारण है: sweep कई मिनट चलता है और GUI को उसकी स्थिति दिखाने तथा स्वतंत्र execution path को मारे बिना रोकने में सक्षम होना चाहिए। सुरक्षित granularity केवल points के बीच है—एक fit atomic है—इसलिए cancel चल रहे fit के बाद माना जाता है, उसके बीच नहीं। callback बुलाने वाले स्वतंत्र execution path पर inline चलता है; उसे block नहीं करना चाहिए। callback द्वारा उठाया गया अपवाद निगला नहीं जाता, बल्कि sweep रोक देता है, क्योंकि टूटा progress reporter caller की bug है और उसे छिपाने से sweep बिना निगरानी चलता रहेगा।
